title: v2 by ominousvibes
features:
Changes:
- Event Notifiers notify you 3 rooms beforehand
- It can now alert you of ambush as well as rush spawns
- Always succeed Heartbeat minigame (Room 50 & 100)

Current Features:
- Figure ESP
- Library Book ESP
- Speed Boost (Subtle)
- Character Glow (Client only)
- Event Notifiers (Notifies you 3 rooms beforehand and if it's Rush / Ambush when they spawn)
- Heartbeat minigame (Failing the minigame will not kill you)
- Remove Ambient (WIP, removes unnecessary sound effects)

Profile: https://v3rmillion.net/member.php?action=profile&uid=1265584

Original: https://v3rmillion.net/showthread.php?tid=1184088
